rules.headings: Use tracking-tight for all headings. Avoid generic bold; use ExtraBold (800) or Light (300) for contrast. Do not center-align headings unless necessary.
rules.body: leading-relaxed for paragraphs. Text color must be #1A1A2E for high contrast readability.

rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. White text on Primary, Text color on backgrounds.
rules.accents: Use Bright Green (#2ECC71) for outline icons, progress bars, and hover states ONLY.
rules.buttons: Primary button: bg-[#1A5C3A] text-white hover:bg-[#2ECC71]. Secondary: border-[#1A5C3A] bg-transparent text-[#1A5C3A] hover:bg-[#E8F5EE].

visual_enhancers.radii: 16px (rounded-2xl) for cards, images, and modals. rounded-full for primary buttons and badges.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, soft ambient shadows on cards on hover: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]. Default state is flat or very light shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5}. Always use Bright Green (#2ECC71) for icons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays for the dark green sections to add premium depth.

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Use the 'Tetris' bento grid for services and store features. Mix col-span-1, col-span-2, row-span-2 to create asymmetry. Gap must be gap-6 or gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections should have py-24 or py-32. Cards should have p-8 or p-12.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and headings. Avoid center-everything disease.

motion.scrolling: Use lenis for smooth scrolling momentum.
motion.interactions: Hover states must include transform scale (hover:-translate-y-1) and slight shadow increase. Buttons must have active:scale-95.
motion.transitions: Avoid 'transition-all'. Use specific transition-transform, transition-colors with duration-300 ease-out.

accessibility.contrast: Meet WCAG AA standards. Use APCA contrast principles.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='quote-form-submit').

pages_and_components.homepage: Bento grid for services. Prominent QualiRépar badge. Trust signals. Large hero with the repair close up.
pages_and_components.quote_form: Multi-step wizard with step indicator on /devis. Use framer-motion for smooth transitions between steps. Large hit areas for touch devices.
pages_and_components.store_locator: Bento layout with map on one side and store cards on the other. Include 'Get Directions' CTA on /magasins.
pages_and_components.faq: Shadcn accordion styled with mint green backgrounds for open state on /faq.
pages_and_components.b2b: Professional tone, features the enterprise image. Emphasize fleet management on /entreprises.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided by the user. Do not introduce generic tailwind blues or grays.
Build a Multi-step quote form (/devis) using React Hook Form and Shadcn. Include progress indicators.
Create a fully responsive navbar and footer. Footer must contain links to all pages and locations.
Implement the 'QualiRépar' logo prominently on the homepage and services pages.
Use Lucide icons, colored in Bright Green (#2ECC71).
Do not use generic center-aligned layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids for features and services.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Never use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays.
Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, ensuring readability.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (rounded-full or rounded-xl) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use the specified icon library (Lucide).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., py-24, p-8).
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components, customized to fit the brand.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
